description: Five controls that connect and disconnect a cable rather than muting it, so the module downstream reads a disconnected row as nothing patched at all, which differs from receiving 0V

params.text: Connects or disconnects that row while nothing is patched to the control input of the same row

inputs.text: The signal for that row, 1 to 16 channels, copied to the output of the same row while that row is connected
Takes over that row from its button: as a gate the row connects above 1V and disconnects below 0.1V, holding between those levels; as a trigger each rising edge toggles the row

outputs.text: Carries the input of the same row while connected, and is set to zero channels while disconnected, so cables leaving it draw faint and read as unpatched

menu: Use triggers for control — switches every control input from gate to trigger, and the word printed on the panel changes from GATE to TRIGGER
Anti-click ramping on #1 — fades row 1's voltages down over 2.5ms before disconnecting and back up after reconnecting; rows 2 to 5 have an item of their own
Anti-click ramping — on a row button's own menu, not the panel menu: the same fade for that one row; a ramp symbol marks a button that has it on
